findings.title: Direct API Key and LLM Provider Usage Bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct calls using GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY instead of utilizing central model router service

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert intelligence synthesis to route calls via the model router client.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing policy, observability, and fallback handling.

findings.title: Model Router Call Log File Missing

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and populates the log directory and call_log.jsonl for auditing and latency tracking.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into LLM usage, routing accuracy, and invocation latencies.
